obligations.expected_behavior: Bind every replay result to a complete Current Snapshot.
forbidden_result: A replay result is unbound from its Current Snapshot.
The bound snapshot is incomplete or partial.
obligations.observable_result: The replay result records an association with a complete Current Snapshot whose required contents are present.
obligations.state_after: The replay result is associated with a complete Current Snapshot.
obligations.state_before: A replay result may lack a binding to a complete Current Snapshot.
obligations.subject: Replay result snapshot binding
obligations.trigger: When a replay result is produced.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reproduce replay results from a fresh checkout.
forbidden_result: Reproduction requires pre-existing local state or uncommitted workspace contents.
A fresh checkout produces a different result without an explicitly permitted change.
obligations.observable_result: Running the replay from a fresh checkout reproduces the recorded result.
obligations.state_after: The replay result is reproducible from a fresh checkout.
obligations.state_before: The replay may depend on workspace state that is not present in a fresh checkout.
obligations.subject: Fresh-checkout replay reproducibility
obligations.trigger: When replay is executed from a fresh checkout.

obligations.expected_behavior: Treat a replay result as stale or fail closed when unexplained result-determining input drift is detected.
forbidden_result: Silently accepting the result as current after unexplained result-determining input drift.
Returning a valid-looking replay result without marking it stale or failing closed.
obligations.observable_result: The result is marked stale or replay processing fails closed after unexplained result-determining input drift.
obligations.state_after: The affected replay result is stale or the replay operation is closed without accepting it.
obligations.state_before: Result-determining inputs have drifted without an explanation, while the result could otherwise be treated as valid.
obligations.subject: Unexplained result-determining input drift handling
obligations.trigger: When unexplained drift in a result-determining input is detected during replay validation or use.
